messages:
kevin_sales: Heads up, SecureMed procurement raised a SIG item asking for vendor-signed risk acceptance if HSM-backed keys are not available for inference caches. This is blocking their POC. Can we scope an exception?

nina_sec_eng: What exactly do they want in the signed doc?

kevin_sales: Heres the text: 'If vendor cannot provide hardware-backed KMS attestation for in-memory caches, provide compensating controls and an official vendor risk acceptance that will be reviewed by our InfoSec.'

omar_prod: Product clarity: Hosted cannot furnish HSM attestation for ephemeral memory. We do support CMEK for persisted storage and Dedicated/Private can integrate with customer HSMs. We should propose controls + offer Dedicated for their POC.

nina_sec_eng: Draft compensating controls for hosted:
```
- Ephemeral-only cache with default TTL of 60s, configurable to 15s.
- No write-to-disk policy; strict GC on session termination.
- CMEK for logs and any persisted artifacts; customer-provided key for blob storage.
- Endpoint ACLs and mTLS across services.
- Detailed audit trails of key access events, 2FA for personnel with key access, and quarterly attestation reports.
```

helen_legal: For the official risk acceptance we need: clear scope (hosted inference only), list of controls, who owns residual risk, approved signers (security lead + CISO), and a disclaimer about future feature availability. Keep customer-facing text non-technical.

kevin_sales: They asked for this today. Nina, can you lead the internal memo? Omar can draft the customer paragraph.

nina_sec_eng: On it. Ill classify residual risk as 'moderate' for this case and request CISO approval. Also will note that Dedicated can use HSM for the POC if they require attestation.

devops-bot: Note: SEC-2094 created for SecureMed HSM exception request. Reviewers set: nina_sec_eng, helen_legal, ciso.

omar_prod: Draft customer text: "Hosted Redwood inference uses ephemeral in-memory caches with strict isolation and short TTLs; while hardware-backed attestation for ephemeral memory is not available in hosted mode, Redwood provides customer-managed encryption for persisted artifacts, enhanced auditability, and an approved vendor risk acceptance for this deployment. If HSM attestation is required, Dedicated/private deployment options are available."

kevin_sales: Perfect. Nina please ping when the internal memo is ready so we can get signatures. Tagging @helen_legal @omar_prod.
